explanation.ar: باستخدام العناصر التي تتكرر في لاحقته
explanation.en: Recursive Suffix-Based Pattern Growth Methods are techniques used to discover frequent sequential patterns by extending an existing pattern step by step using items that frequently occur in its suffix.

options.en: every possible transaction regardless of the pattern
commonly associated with sequential pattern mining

explanation.en: This approach is commonly associated with sequential pattern mining, rather than traditional transaction-based association rule mining.
